A->B.estimator: pooled mean of per-question differences, clusters resampled

equivalence_interval.basis: TOST at alpha=.05 per side = the 90% two-sided interval (main.tex L2205-2206: t_{0.95,35}*SD/sqrt(36)); PREREG.md L306/L591-593 name the TOST interval without a level

rank_test.test: Wilcoxon signed-rank, zeros dropped, two-sided, on the per-question differences over the paired CQs (the variants' CQ intersection)
rank_test.source: main.tex (Three decisions paragraph and decision table); PREREG.md registers no rank-test or sign-agreement rule

G1_silent_over_credit.reason: Clopper-Pearson upper bound does not meet 10%
G1_silent_over_credit.method: Clopper-Pearson (bootstrap is prohibited for this quantity)

g1_achievable_at_registered_n.note: Registered G1 decision above is unchanged. Even with 0 events the one-sided Clopper-Pearson bound exceeds the threshold at this n: G1 is unpassable by construction.

upper_bound_both_levels.note: PREREG L564 (sec.4) specifies one-sided 97.5%; the sec.2 G1 table/prose wording uses 95%; L387-390 flags the mismatch as unresolved. Both bounds are shown; only the level named in decision_uses decides G1.

G2_intra_rater_qwk.reason: washout rater_L1 scores and a clustered CI are required

G3_negative_control.reason: analysis rule: ablated_control and preserved_control rows are excluded from every human-label-based statistic, and their label values are not read unless --controls-valid asserts that they are valid; registered G3 needs the evaluator's A on all 24 ablated cells and >= 22/24 unsupported; ablated_control rows in the run: 24, with a label cell: 8, unlabeled: 16
reasons: analysis rule: ablated_control and preserved_control rows are excluded from every human-label-based statistic, and their label values are not read unless --controls-valid asserts that they are valid
registered G3 needs the evaluator's A on all 24 ablated cells and >= 22/24 unsupported; ablated_control rows in the run: 24, with a label cell: 8, unlabeled: 16
preserved_control rows in the run: 12, with a label cell: 4, unlabeled: 8
all control rows: 36 in the run, 12 with a label cell, 24 unlabeled (counted by presence; no value was read)
G3_negative_control.counted_by: presence of a label cell, never by value

G4_human_judge_qwk.reason: judge-vs-rater L1 agreement is withheld from the rater until the washout relabel is complete (protects G2); full values in the sealed file

G5_mae_judge_human.reason: judge-vs-rater L1 agreement is withheld from the rater until the washout relabel is complete (protects G2); full values in the sealed file

G6_consistency.reason: non-Qwen judge scores are absent or incomplete; G6 cannot pass

value.elapsed_basis: total dwell: the sum of elapsed_s over ALL saves of a cell (a re-save adds its time); a cell is counted under 20 s only if every save has a usable elapsed_s and the total is < 20 s

G7_audit_trail.source: labeling audit trail (label_assist .audit.jsonl), labeled primary cells only; judge-run telemetry is not read; (b) also compares the label CSV with the last audit save; (c) uses the total dwell over all saves of a cell

G8_external_spotcheck.reason: G8 external spotcheck has no registered diagnostic result; not_falsified is not claimed

bootstrap.note: PREREG sec.4 registers BCa, 10,000 resamples, a pre-registered seed and the semantic cluster as the unit; it does not register stratification by category. strata_key=null is the registered scheme. bca_ties=midrank is the scipy BCa convention; strict is the former z0 rule, kept only as a sensitivity switch.

analysis_population.rule: primary cells only (cell_kind == 'primary'); ablated_control and preserved_control rows never enter Coverage, contrasts, pi-hat, G1, G2, G5, G6, G7 or fragility

registered_design.source: PREREG sec.6-2 L789-795: Q_A = Q minus 13 documented corpus-rare CQs (23 left); Q_B..F = Q minus 3 of them (33 left); 23 + 5*33 = 188 primary cells (the CQ lists are in PREREG, not repeated here)

contrasts_family.rule: Holm over the registered family of m=2 (A->B, B->B'). A member that is not computable stays in the family, so a lone computable contrast is adjusted by m=2: p_holm = min(1, 2p).

contrasts_note: Holm applied over the registered family of m=2 confirmatory contrasts; a not-computable member (see contrasts_family) remains a member, so A->B alone gets min(1, 2p). 'resolved' means the 95% BCa interval excludes 0. The Wilcoxon signed-rank test is computed and reported (rank_test) but does NOT change 'decision': the manuscript (main.tex) additionally requires the rank test to agree in sign, PREREG.md registers no such rule, and decision_if_manuscript_rule shows that variant. Holm's input p is the Wilcoxon p (PREREG.md registers the Holm family, not the p-value source). Everything else is exploratory and takes BH-FDR.

pi_hat.estimand: pi = Pr[J >= 2 AND A == 0] over primary cells (cell level)

fragility_pi_interval.registered_text: PREREG sec.4 L574-584, item 2: adversarially demote labels one step until the pi interval exceeds 10%, and report how many
reasons: unit of a move is undefined for pi: item 1 moves a CQ by lowering its paired A->B delta one step, but the text does not say whether a move for pi flips one cell's A (1->0), every J>=2 cell of a CQ, or a CQ-level quantity

'the pi interval' is not pinned to one interval: sec.1.1 headlines the cell-level 95% BCa upper limit, G1 gates the cluster-level one-sided Clopper-Pearson bound, and the level of the latter is itself unresolved (L387-390)

'the cells most favourable to the hypothesis' has no order or tie rule for pi (every flip adds exactly one event) and no K threshold is registered for item 2 (K=6 is the G6 threshold, attached to item 1)

label_provenance.meaning: human-adjudicated AI draft: AI-drafted, rater-revised (PREREG sec.11, L1144-1172)
label_provenance.must_not_be_described_as: independent blind human judgement (PREREG sec.11, L1157-1159)
label_provenance.inflation_direction: upward: AH-vs-judge agreement is inflated by the anchoring of the AI draft (PREREG sec.11, L1160-1162, which requires the direction to be stated with the numbers)
label_provenance.implied_for_statistics: derived, not PREREG text: disagreement-based statistics (pi-hat, G1) are biased down and agreement-based ones (G4 QWK, G5 MAE) toward agreement
label_provenance.applies_to: every label-based statistic in this file

order_drift.reading: PREREG L551 names an order-drift diagnostic but does not define it; most literal reading: labels (A, rater_L1) of labeled primary cells vs the order in which they were saved (rank of the last save timestamp in the labeling audit); descriptive only, no test, no p-value
order_drift.order_basis: rank of the last save ts per cell (ties: sheet row, cell_id)
order_drift.redaction_note: mean_rater_L1 per bin removed from the rater-safe copy (seal); kept in the sealed file

ah_correction.definition: share of labeled primary cells (that have a draft) whose human A differs from the AI draft's A, plus the share whose span was edited, overall and by CQ category; descriptive only (PREREG sec.11, L1166-1167)

output_policy.main_json: aggregates only; no cell-level judge/human value and no cell or CQ identifier
